##### Project general facts

Anta Oasis by Wyndham represents a visionary partnership between the experienced ANTA Group and the globally renowned Ramada Encore by Wyndham, one of the world's largest hospitality networks. This landmark development marks the first Ramada Encore property in Bali offering private investment units, bringing the prestige and operational excellence of a global brand to one of the island's most coveted locations. With a diverse collection of hotel rooms and private villas, the project is designed to deliver exceptional returns through professional management and access to Wyndham's vast loyalty network of millions of members worldwide. Every detail, from development to dividend distribution, is managed with transparency and precision, ensuring investors enjoy a truly hands-off luxury experience.

Water is the defining element of the Anta Oasis experience, serving as a source of energy and inspiration throughout the resort. The centerpiece is the largest lagoon pool on the Bukit Peninsula, a stunning aquatic paradise spanning expansive grounds. An infinity rooftop pool offers breathtaking ocean views, while a private, full-service beach provides exclusive access to the turquoise waters of the Indian Ocean. Guests and residents will also enjoy a world-class spa focused on holistic wellness, a state-of-the-art fitness center, and multiple dining venues including a European cuisine restaurant and a signature rooftop restaurant. For families, the innovative Camp 360 children's development program offers language instruction and enriching activities, while coworking spaces, an open-air cinema, and a grill area ensure endless opportunities for relaxation and connection.

Every residence at Anta Oasis is crafted to reflect modern sophistication and effortless comfort. From the stylish Superior Suites to the expansive three-bedroom villas, each unit features premium finishes, thoughtfully designed layouts, and high-quality materials throughout. The interiors are bathed in natural light, creating airy sanctuaries that seamlessly connect with the tropical surroundings. Villas offer generous living spaces, private terraces, and fully equipped kitchen amenities, ensuring the perfect environment for both short-term getaways and extended stays. Every detail, from the contemporary furnishings to the elegant bathroom fixtures, reflects an uncompromising commitment to quality and refined island living.

##### Parking 
Shared parking. 

##### Location description and benefits

Perched on the prestigious Bukit Peninsula, this exceptional location places visitors at the heart of Bali's most exclusive coastal enclave. Known as the island's "Uluwatu" region, the Bukit is renowned for its dramatic limestone cliffs, world-class surf breaks, and some of the most pristine beaches in Southeast Asia. The area is home to a collection of legendary white-sand shores, including the stunning Pandawa Beach, known as the "Secret Beach," as well as Melasti, Green Bowl, and Padang Padang, each offering unique charm and unparalleled beauty.

The location's strategic advantages are equally compelling. Situated just minutes from the Bali National Golf Club and the Bukit Pandawa Golf & Country Club, the area attracts discerning travelers seeking luxury recreation. World-class resorts such as The Ritz-Carlton and The Apurva Kempinski are nearby, solidifying the region's reputation as a premier destination for sophisticated travelers. The international airport is easily accessible, while an exclusive helipad nearby offers the ultimate convenience for those arriving by air taxi.

Perhaps most compelling is the Bukit's emergence as Bali's most sought-after investment destination. Consistently ranked as the number one island in the world by leading travel publications, Bali offers investors exceptional rental yields and rising property values in a market with year-round tourist demand. With its dramatic coastline, vibrant cultural scene, and reputation as a top global wellness destination, this location represents the pinnacle of tropical luxury livingwhere pristine nature meets sophisticated resort lifestyle in one of the world's most celebrated island paradises.
